instruction: Open https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/waterlevels.html?id=8443970. Prepare and request Boston station 8443970 six-minute observed water levels for 2025-09-12 through 2025-09-13, in metres relative to MLLW and GMT. Use observed water levels, not predictions. The evaluated endpoint is initiation of the correctly configured data request; a saved file is not required. Use Data Only to initiate the JSON observation-data request.
